crossRefs.note: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May Yahweh deal kindly with you…
Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by Yahweh, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and…
He said, “You are blessed by Yahweh, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning…
Saul said, “You are blessed by Yahweh; for you have had compassion on me.
For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you…
David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself…
Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

people.line: A town in Gilead, loyal to Saul

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.
translations.bsb: So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead to tell them, “The LORD bless you, because you showed this kindness to Saul your lord when you buried him.
translations.kjv: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.
translations.asv: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of Jehovah, that ye have showed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.
